text:
alex: Orchard (dedicated cluster: dc-orch-12) is hitting 429s for gen endpoints since 15:08 UTC. Customer reports "slow API" and "throttled" errors. We see admission control rejects. Need help triaging ASAP.

alex: Quick notes: spike started ~15:07, sustained for ~6m, model: gpt-redwood-13b, route: /v1/generate, region: us-west-2, failing clients = ~12 keys.

alex: Example failing request (redacted api key):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-13b","input":"hello","max_new_tokens":512}'
```

alex: Error body we return: `{"error":"admission_reject","reason":"burst_credits_exhausted","code":429}`

ops-bot: ALERT: Dedicated admission_reject rate > 30/s for dc-orch-12 between 15:07-15:14. Link: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/dc-orch-12/admission (chart) :rotating_light:

arjun: pinging eng-runtime. Can you pull admission-control logs and burst credit state for orchard? Also need current tps for the cluster and queue length.

maria: I'm on it. Running quick checks — can anyone run `kubectl top pods -n dedicated-dc-orch-12` and paste output? suspect noisy neighbor or hotspot on a small GPU pool.

alex: paste from ktop run: `kubectl top pods -n dedicated-dc-orch-12` ->
```
NAME                                  CPU(cores)   MEMORY(bytes)
serve-0                                2200m       10Gi
serve-1                                2100m        9.8Gi
sidecar-kvcache-0                      150m         200Mi
controller-0                            50m         300Mi
```

maria: GPU utilization on serve-0/1 at spike peak: ~98% sustained, queue length (pending requests) jumped to ~1.2k. That matches admissions tripping.

arjun: Need admission control debug logs. alex, can you grep for admission messages and paste a 10-line sample? use `kubectl logs controller-0 -n dedicated-dc-orch-12 | grep admission`

alex: sample: 
```
[15:08:11] admission_check: client_id=orchard-prod-32 requests=45/s token_rate=1200 tps_limit=1000 burst_credits=0 -> REJECT reason=burst_credits_exhausted
[15:08:12] admission_check: client_id=orchard-prod-18 requests=60/s token_rate=1600 tps_limit=1500 burst_credits=0 -> REJECT reason=burst_credits_exhausted
```

arjun: confirms burst credits are 0. Looks like sustained overcommit drained credits quickly. Was there a sudden traffic fanout from Orchard? any retry storms?

jess: Customer on a call: they say a downstream job fan-out hit their API at 15:05 — they had a misconfigured backoff. They're extremely impacted (timeouts on UX). Asking for temporary mitigation.

maria: Short-term mitigations we can try (pick one):
- increase min_replicas for dc-orch-12 via admin API to add headroom (quick, takes ~90s to scale)
- enable `admission.allow_overcommit=true` for the cluster (risky but will reduce 429s temporarily)
- route spike traffic to smaller model variant (gpt-redwood-7b) as fallback via routing rule (lowers tps/token rate)

arjun: Also confirm noisy neighbor: no other high-traffic tenants on that GPU pool in last 30m. This is primarily Orchard's spike.

samir (billing-bot): Billing note: Orchard's purchased burst_credits balance = 0 as of 15:06 UTC. They are on monthly reserved capacity + 1M burst credit pack (consumed). They need a top-up to avoid reoccurrence.

jess: Customer asks for whichever mitigations fastest — they prefer not to change their model. Please try scale-up first.

maria: Doing scale now: `POST /admin/clusters/dc-orch-12/scale {"min_replicas":4}` -> scaling triggered. ETA ~75s.

ops-bot: Scaling event recorded: cluster dc-orch-12 min_replicas changed 2->4 by maria at 15:09:47 UTC.

maria: After new replicas warmed (15:11), CPU and GPU utilization dropped to ~65%, queue length down to ~120, admission rejects fall to ~3/s.

alex: Customer confirms errors mostly cleared at 15:12, still seeing occasional 429s for long requests.

arjun: Postmortem checklist items:
- reproduce: run a controlled 10m ramp to 1.5x baseline TPS with curl/ab against dedicated route and verify admission behavior (we have a repro script).
- add a guard in routing to fallback to smaller model on sustained admission rejections.
- tune admission headroom config for dedicated offerings (suggest increase default headroom from 10% -> 20% for 4+ replica pools).
- add billing alert when burst_credits <= 10% to warn customers and SRE.

alex: repro snippet (use `hey` or `wrk`):
```
hey -n 20000 -c 200 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -D body.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jess: I'll coordinate customer comms and offer temporary credit top-up. Samir, please propose a one-time emergency credit and a billing message.

samir: proposing a 200k token emergency top-up and a follow-up email with recommended backlog throttling patterns and backoff guidelines.

maria: Follow-ups for eng-runtime:
- expose more granular admission metrics (per-client burst spend) in console
- consider a soft-fail fallback (route to 7b) when per-client rejects exceed threshold for >30s

arjun: assigning follow-up tickets: INF-4023 (admission headroom tuning), INF-4024 (per-client metrics), CS-289 (customer credit & comms).

alex: Thanks all. Logging notes and snippets uploaded to thread: https://internal.docs/support/threads/1791234567 (internal). :white_check_mark:

jess: Customer happy with mitigation for now, will monitor. Closing here once follow-ups created. :thumbsup:
